architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Routes via React Router. State: React Context + local component state. Styling: CSS Modules. Data fetching: native fetch. No new deps unless native/std fails. Ponytail: no Redux (overkill for current screens), add when cross-page state >3 screens or undo/redo needed.

tickets.title: Build splash screen (src/pages/SplashScreen.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch splash screen to React. Static content only. Auto-redirect to /dashboard after 2s. Use CSS animations for fade-in/out.

tickets.title: Build dashboard home page (src/pages/DashboardHome.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch dashboard. Static mock data for cards, announcements, quick actions. Responsive grid layout. CSS Modules for styling.

tickets.title: Build registration form (src/pages/Registration.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch registration form. Formik for form state. Yup for validation. Submit button disabled until valid. Error messages match Stitch.
acceptance_criteria: Submit disabled until all fields valid

tickets.title: Build product catalog event detail (src/pages/EventDetailKatalogProduk.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch event detail screen. Static mock data for event details, product list. Responsive layout. CSS Modules for styling.

tickets.title: Build product detail page (src/pages/ProductDetail.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch product detail screen. Static mock data for product info, images, specs. Responsive layout. CSS Modules for styling.

tickets.title: Build exams schedule calendar (src/pages/ExamsSchedule.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch exams calendar. Static mock data for events. Use react-big-calendar for calendar UI. CSS Modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar events match Stitch mock data

tickets.title: Build homework search page (src/pages/HomeworkSearch.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch homework search. Static mock data for search results. Search bar functional (client-side filter). CSS Modules for styling.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Navigation bar matches Stitch design. React Router setup for all pages. Route guards for auth (ponytail: mock auth, replace with real when backend ready).
acceptance_criteria: Splash screen redirects to dashboard after 2s
